name: gowayy
description: GOWAYY — connected travel, transport, hospitality and local commerce platform

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.dev:all: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web & npm run dev:partner & npm run dev:admin
scripts.build:all: npm run build:customer && npm run build:partner && npm run build:admin
scripts.brands: node scripts/build-mascot.mjs && node scripts/build-app-brands.mjs && node scripts/rasterize-brand.mjs && node scripts/build-onboarding-animations.mjs && node scripts/build-onboarding-assets.mjs
scripts.assets:build: node scripts/build-brand-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-onboarding-animations.mjs && node scripts/build-onboarding-assets.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:mobile && npm run typecheck:partner-mobile && npm run typecheck:admin-mobile && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:supabase && npm run test:edge && npm run scan:secrets && npm run build
scripts.test:edge: deno check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/gowayy-api/index.ts supabase/functions/payment-webhook/index.ts supabase/functions/push-dispatcher/index.ts supabase/functions/tests/shared.test.ts supabase/functions/tests/phone-push.test.ts && deno test --allow-env --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/tests/
scripts.bundle:mobile:web: cd apps/gowayy-customer/mobile && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir /tmp/gowayy-mobile-web
scripts.bundle:mobile:android: cd apps/gowayy-customer/mobile && npx expo export --platform android --output-dir /tmp/gowayy-mobile-android
